reason: Free during beta is the first red flag — I hunt deals, not mystery apps that want an account so they can charge me later. I still have to file myself on the official site anyway, and I almost never actually sit down and do that.
objection: If it's free during beta, what's the catch later? You get my info, then a fee shows up, or the listings are junk until I waste time checking the real site.
would_change_my_mind: A posted price with no bait-and-switch, and you flag the no-proof settlements I actually qualify for so I'm not verifying every listing myself.
